Prepare step by step

  1. Identify the referring and receiving offices without entering patient details here.
  2. Ask who is responsible for authorization, records transfer and scheduling.
  3. Record dates shown by the original source and the next follow-up point privately.
  4. Confirm clinical questions directly with a qualified member of the care team.
